description: This file is a shell script containing tests for Git branch commands, specifically testing branch filtering options like --contains, --no-contains, --merged, and --no-merged, including patterns and combined filters.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the supplied commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs the command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output of a command is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files or values for equality.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or state.

methods.name: git checkout
methods.description: Switches branches or restores working tree files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
